title: Letter 148
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Letters (Theodoret) > Letter 148

paragraphs.text: Is <quote>the minute of the most holy bishop Cyril, delivered to Posidonius, when sent by him to Rome, in the matter of Nestorius.</quote> (Cyrill. Ep. XI. tom. lxxvii. 85.)
